issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Controller: Cannot create BIG after HCI reset
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
There seems to be some leakage that prevents the host from creating a new BIG after a HCI reset, and a power cycle on the board seems to be the only workaround. 

**To Reproduce**
on the nRF5340:
Using https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/58914 with the bt audio shell (compile with audio.conf) on the appcore, and the https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/tree/main/samples/bluetooth/hci_rpmsg sample with https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/samples/bluetooth/hci_rpmsg/nrf5340_cpunet_iso_receive-bt_ll_sw_split.conf on the network core, do the following in the shell: 

```
bt init sync
bap init
bt adv-create nconn-nscan ext-adv name-ad
cap_initiator ac_12 16_2_1
bt adv-data discov
bt per-adv-param
bt per-adv-data
bap start_broadcast
bt per-adv on
bt adv-start
```

and then do a HCI reset (I did it by running the shell as a `native_posix` application and restarting the application, and do the same above commands again. First attempt works and results in a broadcast source. Second attempt fails at creating the big: 

```
uart:~$ bap start_broadcast
[00:00:02.270,000] <wrn> bt_hci_core: bt_hci_cmd_send_sync: opcode 0x2068 status 0x0c
[00:00:02.270,000] <dbg> bt_bap_broadcast_source: bt_bap_broadcast_source_start: Failed to create BIG: -5
Unable to start broadcast source: -5
```

**Expected behavior**
Expect to create a broadcast source after a HCI reset. 

**Impact**
Annoyance

**Logs and console output**
[btmon.txt](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/files/11706867/btmon.txt)

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: 028e0a3c8d75fc5e2027f54dbb5a55aadbb1c490

**Additional context**
N/A
